quote: We validate G2IS across multiple domain benchmarks. As shown in Figure , our method achieves exceptional performance with only 1% of the training data, outperforming full-data instruction tuning on most tasks.
To validate our method, we focus on two key areas: data selection for single-task optimization and gradient-based selection for multi-task instruction tuning.
outputs: The paper focuses on instruction tuning for domain-specific LLMs, where the generated outputs are responses to task-specific instructions, including reasoning and knowledge-based tasks.

quote: Notably, on the GSM8K dataset using the Gemma-7B model, our approach improves accuracy by 12.66% compared to full instruction tuning.
